---
title: "Machine learning dataset construction and model training"
---

With preprocessed data in hand, the focus shifts to the machine learning core of the pipeline. Everything up to this point has concerned analysis-ready data, whereas from here the concern is ML-ready data, in the sense fixed in the "Processing levels, analysis-ready, ML-ready" definition (see [Overview of the EO data infrastructure landscape](eo_data_landscape.qmd)). This section covers two stages: constructing an ML-ready dataset (see [Constructing a machine-learning-ready dataset](ml_ready_dataset.qmd)) and designing and training the model (see [Model design and training](model_design_training.qmd)). Each stage raises challenges that are specific to the EO context, and the decisions made at these stages directly determine the quality of the pixel-level predictions.
